# The record drag on the physics model dialog's joint page (801): it edits the
# selected joint, not the selected body (EditModeRecord reads
# state.physicsEditorJointPage, which FlipPhysicsDialogPage writes). nodrag.pmd
# is the model after the dialog with the joint page opened and no drag;
# joints.pmd drags joint 2 (move y, shift move x, rotate z) and joint 4
# (rotate x), so the two differ in those joints only. The dialog opened again
# starts on the body page, so a drag there moves a body (body.pmd).
load model .\lips.pmd
save pmd before.pmd
physics model open
dialog click 801
dialog ok
save pmd nodrag.pmd

physics model open
dialog click 801
dialog select 736 2
physics drag move y none 10
physics drag move x shift -4
physics drag rotate z none 25
dialog select 736 4
physics drag rotate x none -15
dialog ok
save pmd joints.pmd
save pmm joints.pmm

physics model open
physics drag move y none 5
dialog ok
save pmd body.pmd
